title: How Many Earths Fit in Each Planet?

segments.text: 1,321 Earths could fit inside this one planet.
Let's fill every planet with Earths, from the smallest to the biggest.
Mercury can't hold even one. Earth could swallow 18 Mercurys!
Mars? Still too small. About 7 Mars fit inside Earth.
Now the giants. Neptune holds 57 Earths. Uranus, 63.
Saturn, with its giant rings? 764 Earths fit inside!
But Jupiter is the king. 1,321 Earths, packed inside one planet!
Yet even Jupiter looks tiny next to the Sun.
The Sun could hold 1.3 million Earths,
or about 1,000 Jupiters. Still think Earth is big?
